 What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Group Summary: 
 Cosma provides a comprehensive range of body, chassis and engineering solutions to global customers. Through our robust product engineering, outstanding tooling capabilities and diverse process expertise, we continue to bring lightweight and innovative products to market.
 
 Job Responsibilities: 







 Department: Information Technology
 Job Level: Junior / Entry Level
 Reports To: IT Operations Manager
 Location: Hybrid / On-site as applicable

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Junior AI Engineer to join our team and help design, develop, integrate, and support artificial intelligence solutions that improve business processes and employee productivity. The Junior AI Engineer will work alongside experienced engineers and IT teams to build process improvement applications using technologies such as: generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning, APIs, automation, software applications and cloud services. This is an ideal opportunity for an early-career engineer who has a strong foundation in software development and wants to gain hands-on experience delivering secure, responsible, enterprise-scale process improvement software.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assist with the design and development of AI-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
 Develop applications that integrate with LLMs, traditional machine learning models, and generative AI services .
 Build and maintain prompts, structured outputs, tool/function integrations, and AI workflows.
 Assist with implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data sources.
 Evaluate model responses for accuracy, relevance, reliability, and overall user experience.
 Participate in prototyping and proof-of-concept development for new AI use cases.
 Software Engineering & Integration 
 Develop and maintain applications and services using Python , .NET , and other supported development languages.
 Build and consume REST APIs and integrate AI capabilities with existing enterprise applications.
 Work with structured and unstructured data from databases, documents, APIs, and business systems.
 Use source control and modern software development practices, including Git, CI/CD, testing, and code reviews .
 Assist with troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimization, and production support.
 Quality, Security & Governance 
 Follow organizational standards for Responsible AI, security, privacy, and data governance .
 Assist with implementing logging, monitoring, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms for applications.
 Ensure sensitive and confidential organizational information is handled appropriately.
 Integrate applications to function with existing CAD, FEA, and PDM software.
 Collaboration & Continuous Learning 
 Translate business requirements into technical prototypes and solutions with guidance from senior team members.
 Stay informed about developments in generative AI, machine learning, software engineering, and CAD/FEA automation.
 Share findings, demonstrations, documentation, and lessons learned with the broader technology organization.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology , related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 0–2 years of professional software development, data, automation, or AI experience.
 Programming experience with Python .
 Understanding of software development fundamentals, including: APIs
 Data structures
 Object-oriented programming
 Source control/Git
 Testing and debugging
 
 Basic understanding of machine learning, generative AI, and large language models.
 Familiarity with JSON, REST APIs, SQL, and common data formats.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience or academic/project exposure to one or more of the following is beneficial:
 Web development
 .NET / development
 CAD and FEA software integration
 AI agents and agentic workflows
 Microsoft Copilot Studio
 Prompt engineering
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 Vector databases and semantic/vector search
 Semantic Kernel or similar AI orchestration frameworks
 Machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
 Docker and containerized applications
 GitHub
 CI/CD pipelines
 SQL and NoSQL databases
 Enterprise identity and security concepts
 Data analytics and visualization
 Knowledge & Skills 
 The successful candidate should demonstrate:
 Curiosity: Strong interest in emerging technologies and experimentation.
 Engineering mindset: Ability to move beyond demonstrations and build maintainable solutions.
 Problem solving: Ability to break complex business problems into manageable technical components.
 Responsible AI awareness: Understanding that AI solutions require attention to security, privacy, bias, accuracy, and human oversight.
 Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
 Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
 Adaptability: Comfortable working in a rapidly evolving technology environment.
 Awareness, Unity, Empowerment: 
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

 
 AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure 
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

 Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making. 
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

Regular / Permanent
